novelty.justification: The claim’s novelty route is a per-example measurement and defense: “a sequence transmits a trait to the degree that the gradient it induces in the student aligns with the trait direction,” with high-alignment sequences then removed or down-weighted. Searches for “subliminal learning per-example gradient alignment filtering,” “training-data attribution gradient similarity trait direction,” and “unsafe training data gradient filtering” identify Cloud et al. (2025), TracIn (Pruthi et al., 2020), Denoised Representation Attribution (2025), and especially Subliminal Learning Is Steering Vector Distillation (2026) as the closest work: collectively they already supply aggregate gradient alignment, example-level gradient attribution/filtering, and evidence that subliminal-data gradients contain a component along the steering direction. Applying these ingredients to rank subliminal-learning sequences against a weight-space trait direction is a non-trivial, semantics-blind operationalization in a new setting, but it is a natural extension of existing attribution and steering-vector mechanisms rather than a new core relationship.
